comparison.objective: Simultaneously release two lid latches, lift the lid, and set it aside.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized bimanual latch translation followed by two-handed lifting.
comparison.success_condition: Both latches released together and lid removed, placed flat, and still without moving the case excessively.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous latch release and extraction, not sequential fastener unlocking, fine rotary adjustment, relocking, or dynamic-cycle validation.
